description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams class, which extends a FilterParams class and includes properties such as empNumber, dateRange, type, and event, along with their accessor and mutator methods. It serves as a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee event searches in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters used in searching employee events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee number, date range, type, and event, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.
